title: config.json's auto_admit block is declared but never read
trigger: Touching admission policy, config.json's schema, or designing any per-type/per-source auto-promotion feature.
behavior_delta: Know that auto_admit in the config is read nowhere: changing it does nothing. DEFAULT_CONFIG.auto_admit (src/store/paths.js:70-76, per memory_type: lesson/anti_memory/procedure/decision/claim, each defaulting to 'candidate') is NOT consumed anywhere in src/ -- confirmed by grepping the whole tree outside node_modules/.dd for `auto_admit`; the only hit is its own declaration. A project's .dd/config.json can override it (this project's does, setting anti_memory to 'active') with zero effect on actual behavior -- every proposal still lands as lifecycle_state:'candidate' via normalizeProposal regardless of this field. Do not assume editing it does anything; do not build a new admission-policy feature by 'just wiring up' this field without first deciding whether its per-type shape is actually the right one, since it was never load-bearing.
